name: Michigan

laws.cite: Michigan Persons with Disabilities Civil Rights Act, MCL 37.1101 et seq.
laws.summary: State disability civil rights law cited by DTMB procedure 1650.02 alongside the ADA as the basis for accessibility obligations.

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web & mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by IFR 2026-07663)
laws.summary: Federal floor: state and local government web content and mobile apps must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA; the April 2026 IFR moved compliance to 2027-04-26 (pop. 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

policy_docs.title: SOM IT Technical Standard 1360.00.11 Digital Standards for Websites and Applications (issued 2025-05-27)
Admin Guide Procedure 1650.02 Accessibility and Reasonable Modifications, ADA Title II (revised 2026-03-23)

applies_to: Executive branch departments, agencies and sub-units: all web and mobile applications incl. COTS, SaaS, vendor-hosted and native mobile apps.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II rule: state government and local governments with population 50,000+ must conform web content and mobile apps to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
ADA Title II rule: local governments under 50,000 and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: eMichigan standards review (form DTMB-3533) before production; issues fixed before release
External and new internal sites/apps at WCAG 2.1 AA; existing internal at next significant UI change
Footer link to SOM web policies incl. Accessibility policy; departments post an accessibility notice
mobile: explicit — standard covers web and mobile apps, naming native mobile apps.
procurement: Applies to developed or procured systems (COTS/SaaS) via the pre-production review; no VPAT/ACR requirement verified in the standard.
enforcement: Administrative gate: eMichigan review must pass before production; exceptions granted by DTMB. Complaints via ADA Title II grievance under 1650.02 / Department of Civil Rights.
notes: No Michigan statute sets a web technical standard; standard derives from DTMB policy 1360.00 and ADA. Full 1650.02 complaint procedure not extracted in detail.
